sections.heading: Progress towards Apple 2030
sections.source_text:
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritising the use of recycled and renewable content and low‑carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment
See the 14‑inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display Product En­viron­men­tal Report (PDF)

sections.heading: Materials
sections.source_text:
The 14‑inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is made with 55% recycled content, 12 including:
100% recycled aluminium in the enclosure
100% recycled cobalt and 95% recycled lithium in the battery
100% recycled copper in multiple thermal module components
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
80% recycled steel in multiple components including the keyboard feature plate

sections.heading: Smarter chemistry

All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification (PDF) , which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern.
